name: Media Droste zoom
doc: The picture holding a framed copy of itself, which holds another, without end: the view dives one level deeper every bar (lurching forward on each beat), so the next frame grows until it is the screen; deeper levels are graded into the palette, each level turns a little against the one around it (the bass winds the spiral tighter), and kicks punch in and light the frames.

palette.doc: the grade of the deeper levels, the frames

ratio.doc: size of the inner frame, share of the picture

cx.doc: where the frames nest (the zoom's centre), uv x

lurch.doc: 0: steady dive, 1: a push on every beat

twist.doc: turn of each level against its parent, radians (bind a bass follower)

bass.doc: the raw bass adds to the twist

kick.doc: kick level (bind an envelope): punch in, frames flash

punch.doc: how far a full kick punches in

mode.doc: develop: deeper levels fade into the palette; alternate: every other level is in palette; natural: the picture everywhere, only tinted

grade.doc: how strong the palette grade is

frame.doc: width of the frames, screen pixels x 4

shadow.doc: drop shadow each frame casts on its parent
